top_violation_types.title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child was put in time out three times during a day, the time out exceeded the appropriated time recommended for the child's age and understanding level.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A 18 mo old was observed to be sitting in a highchair upon arrival. A volunteer was observed removing the child from the chair and telling them they could not hit and not to hit again. The caregiver of the gorup initally stated the chair is only used for eating. After being informed of the volunteer's statement, the caregiver then stated it is used but for only 1 minute.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §746.4803)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CCR observed stationary equipment positioned less than six feet from the perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: No diaper changing tables wwere observed in the infant and toddler's rooms.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers had expired CPR and Fist Aid certification.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
